THE RESIDENCE

Jewel Fortune Palace

life at a Fortune Palace apartment will be a sweet experience in every sense. It explores the sweet possibilities of apartment living. Combining the finest elements of luxury and economy Fortune Palace takes shape in a sprawling 1.15 acres of green clad land:-away from the din and bustle of city but close to the conveniences of modern living.

This apartment complex offers 76 well conceived living spaces in Three blocks. Here, you have an amazing variety of choices. That means seventeen types of Luxury apartments. Of course, you have sufficient options to choose :-according to the budget and taste. The project was completed in 2010.
